messages.subject: [IT] DMS maintenance window — Sat 21 Feb 20:00-23:00
messages.plaintextBody:
The document management system will be unavailable this Saturday 21 February from 20:00 to 23:00 for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please save and close any open documents beforehand. No action is required.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
